your_rows.boundary_rationale: Onset: 25:12 opens with the messenger formula and a fresh addressee, "כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה יַ֣עַן עֲשׂ֥וֹת אֱד֛וֹם בִּנְקֹ֥ם נָקָ֖ם לְבֵ֣ית יְהוּדָ֑ה וַיֶּאְשְׁמ֥וּ אָשׁ֖וֹם וְנִקְּמ֥וּ בָהֶֽם" (oshb:Ezek.25.12) — Edom — again a messenger-formula addressee-change cut. In the WEB, “Because Edom has dealt against the house of Judah by taking vengeance, and has greatly offended, and taken revenge on them,” (web:Ezek.25.12). Close (both sides): 25:14 ends "וְנָתַתִּ֨י אֶת נִקְמָתִ֜י בֶּאֱד֗וֹם בְּיַד֙ עַמִּ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְעָשׂ֣וּ בֶאֱד֔וֹם כְּאַפִּ֖י וְכַחֲמָתִ֑י וְיָֽדְעוּ֙ אֶת נִקְמָתִ֔י נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה" (oshb:Ezek.25.14), carrying a PE immediately after. The close itself is a disclosed deviation from the strict recognition formula: the verb clause reads "and they shall know MY VENGEANCE" (an object noun, not "that I am YHWH"), stacked with the utterance-of-the-Lord-YHWH signature, "נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה" (oshb:Ezek.25.14); it belongs to the utterance list (sweep: 81 verses), not the strict recognition list (sweep: 28 verses) or either 2ms/2mp recognition family. Behind this row, 25:11 closed Moab on the strict 3mp recognition + SAMEKH; ahead, 25:15 opens a fresh messenger formula with the addressee change to the Philistines.

Close (both sides): 26:6 ends "וּבְנוֹתֶ֨יהָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּשָּׂדֶ֔ה בַּחֶ֖רֶב תֵּהָרַ֑גְנָה וְיָדְע֖וּ כִּי אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה" (oshb:Ezek.26.6), the strict 3mp recognition formula, with a PE immediately after. your_rows.boundary_rationale: Onset: 26:7 reopens with the messenger formula, "כִּ֣י כֹ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה הִנְנִ֧י מֵבִ֣יא אֶל צֹ֗ר נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֧ר מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֛ל מִצָּפ֖וֹן מֶ֣לֶךְ מְלָכִ֑ים בְּס֛וּס וּבְרֶ֥כֶב וּבְפָרָשִׁ֖ים וְקָהָ֥ל וְעַם רָֽב" (oshb:Ezek.26.7), introducing Nebuchadnezzar's siege by name — a fresh speech unit following the 26:6 close. In the WEB, “For the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Behold, I will bring on Tyre Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, king of kings, from the north, with horses, with chariots, with horsemen, and an army with many people.” (web:Ezek.26.7). Behind, 26:6 closed unit 1 on the recognition formula + PE; ahead, 26:15 reopens with a further fresh messenger formula shifting from direct 2fs address of Tyre's destruction to the scene of the sea-princes' reaction.

your_rows.boundary_rationale: Onset: 26:15 opens with the messenger formula addressed "to Tyre", "כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֛ר אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִ֖ה לְצ֑וֹר הֲלֹ֣א מִקּ֣וֹל מַפַּלְתֵּ֗ךְ בֶּאֱנֹ֨ק חָלָ֜ל בֵּהָ֤רֵֽג הֶ֨רֶג֙ בְּתוֹכֵ֔ךְ יִרְעֲשׁ֖וּ הָאִיִּֽים" (oshb:Ezek.26.15), reopening after the stacked "I YHWH have spoken" + utterance close and SAMEKH at 26:14. In the WEB, “The Lord Yahweh says to Tyre: ‘Won’t the islands shake at the sound of your fall, when the wounded groan, when the slaughter is made within you?” (web:Ezek.26.15). 26:17 embeds the noun "וְנָשְׂא֨וּ עָלַ֤יִךְ קִינָה֙ וְאָ֣מְרוּ לָ֔ךְ אֵ֣יךְ אָבַ֔דְתְּ נוֹשֶׁ֖בֶת מִיַּמִּ֑ים הָעִ֣יר הַהֻלָּ֗לָה אֲשֶׁר֩ הָיְתָ֨ה חֲזָקָ֤ה בַיָּם֙ הִ֣יא וְיֹשְׁבֶ֔יהָ אֲשֶׁר נָתְנ֥וּ חִתִּיתָ֖ם לְכָל יוֹשְׁבֶֽיהָ" (oshb:Ezek.26.17), "lamentation/qinah" — but as REPORTED future speech the sea-princes will voice ("they shall take up a qinah over you"), not a command to the prophet; disclosed here as texture, not treated as a lament_qinah onset. 26:18 ends "עַתָּה֙ יֶחְרְד֣וּ הָֽאִיִּ֔ן י֖וֹם מַפַּלְתֵּ֑ךְ וְנִבְהֲל֛וּ הָאִיִּ֥ים אֲשֶׁר בַּיָּ֖ם מִצֵּאתֵֽךְ" (oshb:Ezek.26.18) with NO recognition, utterance, or "I YHWH have spoken" formula in the verse; a SAMEKH follows immediately (single-witness, tier-3), disclosed as paragraph texture rather than a row-final close, because 26:19 reopens the same messenger formula ("כִּ֣י כֹ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה…", oshb:Ezek.26.19) against the SAME 2fs addressee (Tyre), so no addressee-class shift separates 26:15-18 from 26:19-21 and the mark alone does not license a cut here. Close (both sides): 26:21 ends "בַּלָּה֥וֹת אֶתְּנֵ֖ךְ וְאֵינֵ֑ךְ וּֽתְבֻקְשִׁ֗י וְלֹֽא תִמָּצְאִ֥י עוֹד֙ לְעוֹלָ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהֹוִֽה" (oshb:Ezek.26.21), the utterance-of-the-Lord-YHWH formula, with a SAMEKH immediately after — closing the whole Ezek.26 Tyre-siege chapter before 27:1 opens a fresh strict word-event onset for the qinah proper. Behind this row, 26:14 closed the siege-detail unit on the stacked "I YHWH have spoken" + utterance formulas and a SAMEKH.

your_rows.boundary_rationale: Onset: 28:1 opens with the strict word-event formula, "וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר" (oshb:Ezek.28.1). 28:2 supplies the messenger formula and the addressee, "בֶּן אָדָ֡ם אֱמֹר֩ לִנְגִ֨יד צֹ֜ר כֹּֽה אָמַ֣ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהֹוִ֗ה יַ֣עַן גָּבַ֤הּ לִבְּךָ֙ וַתֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֵ֣ל אָ֔נִי מוֹשַׁ֧ב אֱלֹהִ֛ים יָשַׁ֖בְתִּי בְּלֵ֣ב יַמִּ֑ים וְאַתָּ֤ה אָדָם֙ וְֽלֹא אֵ֔ל וַתִּתֵּ֥ן לִבְּךָ֖ כְּלֵ֥ב אֱלֹהִֽים" — "tell the prince [לִנְגִ֨יד (oshb:Ezek.28.2)] of Tyre" — a title the text itself distinguishes from "the king [מֶ֣לֶךְ (oshb:Ezek.28.12)] of Tyre" at 28:12, disclosed as literature-type context rather than evidence for a separate oracle.
